source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: For the attached project, the required deliverables are permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with an electrical PE stamp; I will handle the Mechanical and Plumbing stamps. Would you be available to support this additional work, and if so, what price and timeline would you quote?

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Given that I understood the scope to cover only review and stamping, could you clarify whether I am also expected to provide additional drawings and calculations?

ambiguity.description: The freelancer understood the assignment as review and stamping only and requested clarification on whether producing the electrical drawings was also required.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: To clarify the scope, you would create and stamp the electrical drawings, while I would stamp the mechanical drawings. You would also perform whatever calculations are required to produce the drawings; please confirm that this is within your competence. The applicable scope includes Manual. J, Manual S, and Manual D.
